name: floatplay
description: Paste a link, watch it in a floating always-on-top mini player over any app.
author: linda xue

scripts.build:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
